region_scene_page.compact: This road revives power-pop's melody and harmony ideals inside 1990s/2000s alt-rock volume, self-awareness, and studio punch.
region_scene_page.standard: This road revives power-pop's melody and harmony ideals inside 1990s/2000s alt-rock volume, self-awareness, and studio punch. Weezer's Undone - The Sweater Song, Fountains of Wayne's Sink to the Bottom, OK Go, and The Lemonheads' Into Your Arms give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.

Weezer's Undone - The Sweater Song, Fountains of Wayne's Sink to the Bottom, OK Go, and The Lemonheads' Into Your Arms give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
